subject: [PATCH v6 14/19] selftests/mm: run every supported collapse order by default

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged selftest to run all supported collapse orders by default, rather than only running a single order when specified with the -c option. The test cases for memory-type huge page (mTHP) collapse are now run once per supported anon THP order below the PMD, and the context is pulled into both the no-argument invocation and the "all" case. The patch also updates the usage message to reflect these changes and adds range checking for the -s and -c options.
